findings.issue: Invents a topic 'the scene' that does not exist in the Japanese. The sentence has a が-marked subject and no topic; the fabricated phrase misrepresents the structure and will baffle learners.
findings.current: As for the scene, the teacher is checking the test scores.
findings.suggested: The teacher (が: subject/new information) is checking the test scores.

findings.issue: Same fabricated topic 'a cena' with no counterpart in the Japanese; there is no は-topic in this sentence.
findings.current: Quanto a [a cena], a professora, as notas da prova, está conferindo.
findings.suggested: A professora (が: sujeito/informação nova), as notas da prova, está conferindo.

findings.issue: Describes に as marking 'the place where the action occurs' — that is で's function. With placement verbs like 植える, に marks the destination/resulting location of the object. This blurs the fundamental に/で distinction.
findings.current: に marks 公園 (park) as the place where the action occurs.
findings.suggested: に marks 公園 (park) as the place where the trees end up (destination of the planting); で is the particle that marks where an action occurs.

findings.issue: Same に/で function error as expl_en: に with 植える marca o destino/local resultante, não 'o local onde a ação ocorre' (função de で).
findings.current: に marca 公園 (parque) como o local onde a ação ocorre.
findings.suggested: に marca 公園 (parque) como o lugar onde as árvores ficam (destino do plantio); quem marca onde uma ação ocorre é で.

findings.issue: 'As for X' is the corpus's device for the topic は, but this sentence has no topic — 公園に is a locative phrase. Presenting に as 'as for' misteaches the structure (compare lit_en of sent:gen-1f0c9535f37c, which correctly uses 'In the bowl').
findings.current: As for the park (に), many cherry trees (object) (someone) planted (past).
findings.suggested: In the park (に), many cherry trees (object) (someone) planted (past).

findings.issue: 'Quanto ao parque' misapplies the topic device to a locative に phrase (no は in the sentence), and '(em-em)' is a duplicated-gloss glitch.
findings.current: Quanto ao parque (em-em), muitas de cerejeiras (objeto) plantou (passado).
findings.suggested: No parque (em), muitas de cerejeiras (objeto) plantou (passado).
